NAME:
   jf - command line client

USAGE:
   jf [global options] command [command options] [arguments...]

VERSION:
   0.0.0

COMMANDS:
     setup    Configures a package manager to use a repository.
     help, h  Shows a list of commands or help for one command

   Command Namespaces:
     config, c  Server configuration commands
     rt         Repository commands

   Lifecycle:
     release-bundle-create, rbc           Creates a release bundle.
     release-bundle-delete-local, rbdell  Deletes a release bundle
                                          when it is no longer needed.

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --help, -h     show help
   --version, -v  print the version
